rule RULE1.explanation: This command configures a source NAT rule within a specified rule-set, defining how traffic matching the rule is translated before leaving the network.

then source-nat pool address-group1.explanation: Configures the address pool that you want to use for the NAT conversion.

parameters.name: pool-name
